executive_summary:
AppLovin combines 53% revenue growth, 64% continuing-profit growth and $863.3m FCF, a substantive operating and cash counterweight to its severe price decline. No independently verified negative catalyst explains that conflict; platform durability and leverage require evidence rather than assumptions of either misconduct or a bargain. Maintain observation; the evidence does not yet establish a directional new-position advantage.

Price is deeply below both major averages with negative MACD and substantial declines across every provided horizon. RSI near 30 and proximity to the observed low permit a rebound but do not confirm one; volatility remains elevated and volume does not validate accumulation. AppLovin has a mixed spending and discount-rate backdrop. The macro layer remains neutral with low confidence because mobile advertising exposure cannot be mapped precisely from these aggregate releases. bull_case: AppLovin has strong continuing-operation growth and near-total CFO-to-FCF conversion. Round two defends a contrarian operating foundation beyond adjusted earnings while making repeatability, leverage and actual stabilisation conditions for the thesis.
bear_case: The bear accepts present cash strength and avoids inventing misconduct or impairment. Its remaining objections are unverified durability, leverage, regulatory exposure and valuation compensation, alongside a severe unconfirmed downtrend.
key_uncertainties: Current leverage and repeatability of platform economics.
Verified regulatory/platform exposure and cause of price weakness.
Platform economics, repeated cash generation and regulatory exposure.
